priorBlocker.wholeSpellGate: The absent outcome contract controls the native central positive question/task or reality-change operation. Optional external exceptions can remain conditional, but cannot replace the required central useful positive witnesses.
priorBlocker.permissionDistinction: The current request permits Director review and spell-local authoring. No previous restriction on new rules is carried as authority. Missing concrete outcome content and legally instantiated positive encounter evidence remain; native delegation and broad promise alone do not prove those witnesses.

closureWorkClassification.directorAuthoring: Define and review complete finite spell-local outcomes, admission, operation order, defenses, continuation and failure settlement; do not label these as pre-existing source facts.

closureWorkClassification.externalEvidence: Only actual unknown/protected facts, physical profiles, exceptional permissions or cosmological claims used by a chosen outcome require the corresponding external record. These are not universal prerequisites for every permissible outcome.
